title: Color format
description: 'hex' emits simple hex color strings for broad compatibility. 'structured' emits DTCG color objects with sRGB components, alpha, and a hex fallback.

title: Dimension value format
description: 'flat' emits legacy-compatible dimension strings ("16px") and 'structured' emits dimension objects ({value,unit}).

title: Include token descriptions
description: When enabled, Supernova token descriptions are exported as DTCG $description values.

title: Preserve unsupported properties in $extensions
description: When a Supernova property has no equivalent in the DTCG spec (e.g. border position, gradient angle/type, typography textCase), store it under a vendor-namespaced $extensions key instead of silently dropping it.

title: Include token types with no DTCG equivalent
description: When enabled, tokens with no sensible DTCG $type (blur, visibility, textCase, textDecoration as standalone tokens) are exported as $type: "string" with their raw value, tagged in $extensions. When disabled, they are skipped and reported in the build log.

title: Output file structure
description: 'single-file' writes one tokens.json. 'per-type' writes one file per Supernova token type (color.tokens.json, typography.tokens.json, etc).

title: Output file name (single-file mode)
description: Base name used for the single output file, without extension.

title: Show Generated File Disclaimer
description: When enabled, a disclaimer showing the fact that the file was generated automatically and should not be changed manually will appear in all style styles
